row.title: KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH-1: every system keeps a knowledge graph via core/knowledge
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-25: all deployments have a knowledge graph that builds and maintains connections across their data and yields autonomous insights. Built as workers/core/knowledge (pure run() over tenant records: entity resolution, provenance edges, PageRank, communities, link leads, insights from snapshot diff). core/discover links enter as labelled leads. Practical Solutions is first tenant. Next: run it from the seed tick so new deployments get it without a tenant script.
